name: Pepper
summary: Pepper is a humanoid robot from SoftBank Robotics. SoftBank Robotics America describes it as "a robot designed for people. Built to connect with them, assist them, and share knowledge with them" and lists retail, banking, education, hospitality and healthcare applications. Specifications, maturity and current availability have not yet been verified.

spec_caveats.text: SoftBank Robotics states 'Height (mm) Width (mm) Depth (mm) 1210 480 425' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/2-5/family/pepper_technical/dimensions_pep.html). Aldebaran/SoftBank Robotics Pepper technical documentation (NAOqi 2.5), arms-down height; 1210 mm = 121 cm.
SoftBank Robotics states 'Leg Wheel center, at floor level' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/2-5/family/pepper_technical/bodyparts_pep.html).
SoftBank Robotics states 'Pepper QiSDK [ Pepper SDK for Android ]' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/index.html).

SoftBank Robotics states 'NAOqi Python - API' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/2-5/dev/programming_index.html). NAOqi programming API documentation for SoftBank Robotics robots (NAOqi 2.5 doc set covering Pepper).

SoftBank Robotics states 'It runs on a desktop and is able to communicate with all the Aldebaran robots.' (http://doc.aldebaran.com/2-5/dev/ros/index_ros.html). The NAOqi ROS documentation states the ROS driver works with all Aldebaran robots, Pepper included.
